extra_template: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: sprite atlas for a high-quality horizontal arcade shooting game. Setting and materials: {theme}. Draw SIXTEEN visually distinct {subject}. Exactly 4 columns and 4 rows in a precise uniform grid, one complete detached object centered in each cell, with generous transparent padding. Intricate hand-painted sci-fi game art with sharp distinctive silhouettes and tactile material detail, viewed from the side or three-quarter side. Objects must not cross cell boundaries. No border, no grid lines, no writing, no symbols, no watermark, no scene or ground. Fully transparent background.

initial_templates.fleet: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: transparent sprite atlas for a high-quality 2D side-scrolling arcade shooter. Create a clean sprite sheet of NINE genuinely distinct {theme}. 3 columns by 3 rows in an exact uniform grid, each object fully contained and centered in its cell with generous transparent padding. Individual detached mechanical subjects only, each silhouette unique and clearly different; avoid duplicates and recolors. Consistent three-quarter side view and cohesive exquisitely detailed hand-painted sci-fi arcade artwork, rich material detail and crisp readable silhouettes, no cast ground shadows, no perspective environment. Exactly one object per cell, no objects crossing cells, no border, no typography, no labels, no watermark. Background must be fully transparent.
initial_templates.scenery: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: sprite atlas for a high-detail horizontal arcade shooting game. Create a sheet of nine distinct, isolated, non-character game objects inspired by {theme}. Arrange exactly 3 columns by 3 rows in a precise uniform grid, each object fully inside its cell, with generous transparent padding. Every cell must contain a distinctly different shape and mechanism, no repeating the same shape. Side-view material rendering, intricate painterly sci-fi artwork, strong readable silhouettes, realistic textured construction and illumination. No frame or grid lines, no ground, no scenic background, no cast shadows, no text, no watermark; fully transparent background.
